draw_source_actor_valid.name: draw_source_actor_valid
draw_source_actor_valid.value: ("raffle_draws"."source"='manual' and "raffle_draws"."actor_id" is not null) or ("raffle_draws"."source"='automatic' and "raffle_draws"."actor_id" is null)

draw_audit_valid.name: draw_audit_valid
draw_audit_valid.value: "raffle_draws"."winner_ticket">=0 and ("raffle_draws"."candidate_count" is null or ("raffle_draws"."candidate_count">0 and "raffle_draws"."random_index">=0 and "raffle_draws"."random_index"<"raffle_draws"."candidate_count"))

media_asset_scope.name: media_asset_scope
media_asset_scope.value: ("media_assets"."kind"='proof' and "media_assets"."purchase_id" is not null and "media_assets"."raffle_id" is null) or ("media_assets"."kind"='image' and "media_assets"."raffle_id" is not null and "media_assets"."purchase_id" is null)

media_asset_status.name: media_asset_status
media_asset_status.value: "media_assets"."status" in ('pending','verified','orphan','cleaning','deleted') and ("media_assets"."status"<>'verified' or "media_assets"."verified_at" is not null) and ("media_assets"."status"<>'cleaning' or ("media_assets"."cleanup_token" is not null and "media_assets"."cleanup_until" is not null)) and "media_assets"."cleanup_attempts">=0

media_asset_size.name: media_asset_size
media_asset_size.value: "media_assets"."size_bytes">0 and (("media_assets"."kind"='image' and "media_assets"."size_bytes"<=2097152 and "media_assets"."mime" in ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp')) or ("media_assets"."kind"='proof' and "media_assets"."size_bytes"<=10485760 and "media_assets"."mime" in ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp','application/pdf')))

outbox_lease_valid.name: outbox_lease_valid
outbox_lease_valid.value: "notification_outbox"."attempts">=0 and "notification_outbox"."status" in ('ready','leased','sent','dead') and ("notification_outbox"."status"<>'leased' or ("notification_outbox"."lease_token" is not null and "notification_outbox"."lease_until" is not null))

occupancy_valid.name: occupancy_valid
occupancy_valid.value: "ticket_occupancy"."ticket_number">=0 and (("ticket_occupancy"."state"='blocked' and "ticket_occupancy"."order_id" is null) or ("ticket_occupancy"."state" in ('reserved','reviewing','sold') and "ticket_occupancy"."order_id" is not null))

payment_method_text.name: payment_method_text
payment_method_text.value: length(trim("payment_methods"."bank")) between 1 and 100 and length(trim("payment_methods"."beneficiary")) between 1 and 200 and length("payment_methods"."instructions") <= 2000

purchase_money_valid.name: purchase_money_valid
purchase_money_valid.value: "purchases"."price_cents">0 and "purchases"."fee_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "purchases"."subtotal_cents">0 and "purchases"."fee_cents">=0 and "purchases"."total_cents"="purchases"."subtotal_cents"

raffle_numbers_valid.name: raffle_numbers_valid
raffle_numbers_valid.value: "raffles"."ticket_count" between 1 and 1000000 and "raffles"."start_number">=0 and "raffles"."start_number"::bigint+"raffles"."ticket_count"-1<=2147483647 and "raffles"."price_cents" > 0 and "raffles"."fee_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "raffles"."prize_cost_cents">=0 and "raffles"."expenses_cents">=0 and ("raffles"."draw_at" is null or "raffles"."draw_at">="raffles"."sales_deadline")
